name: No pasarán
author: Keith Phelan

sections.description:
The least a man can do at such a time is to declare himself and tell where he stands.
– E. B. White

The plugin displays a modal popup, the visitor has to identify as a fascist or an anti-fascist.

Anti-fascists:
* Get a cookie.
* Popup will no longer be displayed.

Fascists:
* Get sent on their way (to the URL configured in Settings > ¡No pasarán!).

Privacy

Visitor’s choice is stored in a browser cookie with a long expiry.

Dev

Available commands:
make version v=1.2.3 – Update version headers
make package – Bundle the plugin into a production ZIP
make clean – Remove build artifacts and the dist/ directory
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings > ¡No pasarán!
  4. Select a preset redirect URL or set Custom.
  5. Save
